en.answer:
No, it is not.

That effect of <<21164>> is a monster effect. It does not apply while it is a Spell Card, so its name does not become "<<6390>>", and remains "<<21164>>".

For example, you cannot return it to the hand in order to activate <<21163>>'s『add 1 "<<4837>>" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand』effect.
